From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security VPC discovery follow-up

Jane / Bob,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end:

- SOC 2 status: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for data hosting and inference. I've attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) that highlights in-scope controls and most recent test period.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support customer-managed data controls and can sign BAAs. For GDPR, we can provide data processing addenda and deletion/retention controls.
- Private/VPC options: See attached deployment diagram (redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf) for our standard VPC private deployment. We support:
  - Shared VPC with dedicated subnets and security groups
  - Customer-controlled peering or transit gateway
  - On-prem / air-gapped install (appliance-based) for regulated workloads — requires a short assessment for the exact network/infra requirements.
- Vendor security questionnaire (SSQ): I'm initiating our vendor SSQ for Acme — you should receive a link from our security portal within the next business day. If you prefer, we can also push a prefilled SSQ PDF first.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll send the VPC deployment diagram + SOC2 summary (attached).
2) Start the SSQ (link below) — please assign your security reviewer (name/email) so we can triage any follow-ups.
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk the diagram and discuss air-gapped options and procurement timeline (proposed: Tue 30 May, 10am PT).

Attachments (stubs): redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf (PDF), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Security VPC discovery follow-up

Marcus —

Thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our security team:

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report covers the most recent 12-month period and whether infra-level controls (patching, vulnerability mgmt for inference hosts) are in scope?
- For the air-gapped on-prem option: our security architect wants to see the network isolation details (how secrets are provisioned, how updates are applied without outbound access).
- Please send the SSQ link; we typically have our security reviewer (Bob Rogers, bob.rogers@acme.com) complete it. He may have some technical follow-ups after that.

We can do the follow-up call — Tue 30 May 10am PT works for us.

Thanks,
Jane

Notes on air-gapped/on-prem:

- Secrets (keys/certs) can be provisioned via your KMS/HSM; we have a PKI onboarding checklist to share on the follow-up.

Let me know if you'd like the SSQ prefilled PDF first (we can attach answers to the common control questions to speed review).
